```{r}
library(terra)

library(dplyr)
```

Import .tif of env stack + convert to SpatRaster

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE FILE PATH FOR MISSION
env_stack_path <- "/Users/keileygregory/THESIS_REPOSITORIES/MISSION_REPOSITORIES/UVI2_Around_STX_20250306/data/6_data_analysis_outputs/maxent_model/1_env_stack_output/maxent_env_stack_1km_UTM20N.tif"

# convert imported GeoTIFF to SpatRaster
env_stack <- rast(env_stack_path)
```

Import humpback occurrences (detections) + LF background CSVs

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE FILE PATH FOR MISSION
hump_csv_path <- "/Users/keileygregory/THESIS_REPOSITORIES/MISSION_REPOSITORIES/UVI2_Around_STX_20250306/data/5_data_gis/LF_gis_data/TIDY_calc_humpback_points_NAD83.csv"
occ_raw <- read.csv(hump_csv_path)

#‼️‼️ UPDATE FILE PATH FOR MISSION
bg_csv_path <- "/Users/keileygregory/THESIS_REPOSITORIES/MISSION_REPOSITORIES/UVI2_Around_STX_20250306/data/5_data_gis/LF_gis_data/TIDY_calc_LF_background_points_NAD83.csv"
```

Output directory

```{r}
#‼️‼️ UPDATE DIRECTORY PATH FOR MISSION
varsel_out <- "/Users/keileygregory/THESIS_REPOSITORIES/MISSION_REPOSITORIES/UVI2_Around_STX_20250306/data/6_data_analysis_outputs/maxent_model/2b_varsel_output/"
```

Prepare **occurrence coordinates in UTM 20N**, deduplicated to one point per 1 km cell (same rule as maxent script (#3) = selection reflects modeled occurrence set)

```{r}
occ_raw <- occ_raw[complete.cases(occ_raw[, c("av_longitude_DD", "av_latitude_DD")]), ]

# Reproject detection pts from 
occ_wgs <- vect(occ_raw, geom = c("av_longitude_DD", "av_latitude_DD"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
occ_utm <- project(occ_wgs, crs(env_stack))

cell_ids <- cellFromXY(env_stack[[1]], crds(occ_utm))
occ_utm  <- occ_utm[!duplicated(cell_ids), ]

occ_xy <- as.data.frame(crds(occ_utm))
colnames(occ_xy) <- c("x", "y")
cat("occurrences after 1-cell deduplication:", nrow(occ_xy), "\n")
```
